top_catalysts.event: Services expand while input prices remain elevated
top_catalysts.status: 已发生；按历史截止线重建
top_catalysts.what_happened: September ISM services registered 54.9, prices 74.0 and employment 50.1. The October 5 release was available only after 22:00SGT, so it first enters theOctober 6 reconstruction.
top_catalysts.what_changed: Headline growth eased from 55.4 while prices rose from 72.6; the report does not support treating weaker payrolls as a complete inflation-resolution signal.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: Companies can face both slower growth and rising operating costs. Margin protection through price increases may prolong the policy constraint on valuation.
top_catalysts.transmission: 温和扩张和高成本→利率路径仍难单边转鸽。 UST2Y is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Company pricing commentary and subsequent inflation readings confirm persistent cost transmission.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Prices normalize and margins stabilize while demand slows, reducing the combined growth-cost constraint.

top_catalysts.event: Improving exports and stock-release pledges pressure oil
top_catalysts.status: 已发生；按历史截止线重建
top_catalysts.what_happened: Reuters reported October 5 settlements of $100.32 for Brent and$89.43 for WTI as increased Middle East exports and G7 supply pledges eased some supply anxiety.
top_catalysts.what_changed: This is a decline from the prior settlement, although a one-session move does not establish that the oil-supply disruption has ended.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: Lower energy costs may support margins and inflation relief. A broader equity benefit requires interest rates or earnings expectations to confirm the improvement.
top_catalysts.transmission: 能源回落→成本缓冲；需观察是否传递至长端利率。 Brent December 2026 is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Verified physical deliveries improve and energy-sensitive inflation compensation declines.
top_catalysts.invalidation: New interruptions reverse the price move or bond yields stay elevated despite the temporary cost relief.

top_catalysts.event: Confirmed consumer and AI-infrastructure earnings are approaching
top_catalysts.status: 官方已确认日程，结果待公布
top_catalysts.what_happened: Lamb Weston scheduled October 6 premarket results, Constellation October 6 after-close results, and Levi and Applied Digital October 7 reports. Their announcement pages were available before this cutoff.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The next evidence will be issuer operating results; market optimism alone is not an observed improvement in revenue quality or cash generation.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: Consumer sell-through and AI recurring rent test different demand channels. GAAP adjustments and funding needs can offset favorable headline revenue growth.
top_catalysts.transmission: 收入质量/现金流/融资→盈利与资本成本检验。 LW is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Original releases demonstrate recurring demand, cash conversion and sustainable operating margins.
top_catalysts.invalidation: One-offs, channel inventory or low-margin construction services account for most of the apparent improvement.
